title: Party Bus or Bike Bar? Pick by What You're Solving For
why: Honest comparison plus real Facebook reviews for warm leads stuck between a party bus and the bike bar; admits when the bus wins so the rest is believable.
hook_options: Party bus or bike bar? Here's when each one wins.
We'll tell you when to book the party bus instead.
The honest answer to bus vs bike bar.
caption: Party bus or bike bar? Honest answer: if it's pouring or you just need a ride between two venues, book the bus. If you want the centerpiece of the weekend, the open-air ride wins. Real reviews in the slides. Send to the group chat before the vote. #neworleans #nolabachelorette #nolabirthday #thingstodoinneworleans

slides.headline: You need A to B, or it's pouring
slides.body: A sealed box is dry and gets you between two venues. We'll say that out loud.
